expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Declares the FTransform3f value type. Constructs the identity transform. Copies another FTransform3f. Constructs an identity rotation and scale with InTranslation. Constructs InRotation with zero translation and unit scale. Constructs a quaternion from InRotation with zero translation and unit scale. Constructs from basis axes and translation. Converts a double-precision FTransform to float32 components. Returns the inverse transform. Replaces this value with a blend from Atom1 to Atom2. @param Alpha Blend weight; 0 uses Atom1 and 1 uses Atom2.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call.
inputs: Nominal values for every listed parameter, one default or empty state, and one behavior-specific boundary derived from the registration notes.
testScope: FTransform3f Value; | FTransform3f Value(); | FTransform3f Value(const FTransform3f& Other); | FTransform3f Value(const FVector3f& InTranslation); | FTransform3f Value(const FQuat4f& InRotation); | FTransform3f Value(const FRotator3f& InRotation); | FTransform3f Value(const FVector3f& InX, const FVector3f& InY, const FVector3f& InZ, const FVector3f& InTranslation); | FTransform3f Value(const FTransform& Transform); | FTransform3f FTransform3f.Inverse() const; | void FTransform3f.Blend(const FTransform3f& Atom1, const FTransform3f& Atom2, float32 Alpha);
